_about: H-fever, the room (D15f, decision 27; the 1 Oct report §8H; js/clinic/heal/games/fever.js). Played in the wide exam room (CB2b), no close-up. A live wall thermometer with a green zone; things round the room cool or warm the patient by their size (things.*.size, in reading units; the zone is -rules.zone..+rules.zone). The patient's fever swings hot and cold; the doctor names the thing to use (levels 1-2), from level 3 the last exchange is 'fix it'. Every swing is sized so the named thing lands in the zone and at least one other thing a non-speaker could pick does too, so the thermometer never gives the answer away (C10). Every word is an English placeholder (data/clinic/lang.json fever-*), to record.

camera._about: D15f: the fever room plays in the wide shot itself (no zoom to a close-up). 'room' asks the heal host to skip the zoom (proposal in build/reports/heal-C.md); until it does, the game removes the zoom layer itself.

rules._about: zone: the green zone's half-width; max: the thermometer's range either side; exchanges per level; fixFrom: the level 'fix it' starts; fixLast: how many exchanges at the end are 'fix it'; gaps: the swing sizes per level (the named thing always lands in the zone); fixGaps: the 'fix it' swings (4 needs two things); icePack: the spare cooler on or off (art plan question 7).

room._about: things: side (cool/warm), size (S02-C, FV9, CLN-105: one number model, each thing adds or takes 2 small, 3 medium, 4 big), fixed (stays where it is: a toggle) or not (goes to the patient). at: where each sits on CB2b, in fractions of the picture (x centre, y its bottom, h and w its size), moved into view when a screen crops the picture (the art plan §3.4 positions; remeasure when the art lands).

window._a2: A2 (5 Oct): R4's open window, registered on the painted one (heal-art.json rooms.window-open): it stays exactly there (hang)

ceiling-fan._a2: A2 (5 Oct): R2 hangs from the ceiling (on the square room's band), the blades at about y 0.13 (art plan 3.4). The button (h) is the motor and blades, always on screen; art = the whole picture's height, the downrod running up off a phone's crop (hang: never pushed down)

hand-fan._s03: S03-C (FV4, FV5): lying flat on the bed, handle towards us (lie: tipped back in code), not standing face-on

heater._a2: A2 (5 Oct): R1's heater on the open floor in front of the bed's left leg, clear of the toys and the rug (it stood on them at x 0.215)
heater._s03: S03-C (FV5, CLN-105): on the floor to the right of the bed, turned to face her (flip), clear of the toys and the door (tablets clamp it into view)

gauge._a2: A2 (5 Oct): R5 on the wall at x 0.76-0.84, y 0.12-0.40 (art plan 3.4), at the picture's own shape

art._about: The art swaps in by file name (docs/design-language/art-plans/clinic-heal-art-plan.md §8, R1, R2, R4, R5): a file that isn't there yet keeps the code-drawn stand-in. <id>-on / <id>-off for things with two states. The gauge (R5) and the ceiling fan (R2, body and spinning blades) need their measured boxes from the cut before they replace the drawn ones.

fan._a2: A2 (5 Oct): R2, the body (downrod and motor) and the blade disc from below; foot = where the motor's cap is, as a share of the body's height; disc = the blades' width against the body's. The code tilts the disc into view and spins it when on.

gauge._a2: A2 (5 Oct): R5, the empty gauge; tube = the glass from its top to the bulb's foot (x0, y0, x1, y1 as shares of the picture), bulb = the bulb's width against the tube's. The level and the zones stay code.
